items.question: In the worked example, if two AED 20 products are returned from an AED 60 order paid partly by voucher or Shukrans, how much is refunded to the credit or debit card?
items.gold: AED 20 (AED 10 per returned product) goes to the credit or debit card.
items.fact: Example return refund split: card receives AED 20 of AED 40
